entries.3b040fd1f04d7950: A single-segment business engaged in retail and wholesale sales of jewelry and related products. As of March 31, 2026, it had 108 stores and 505 employees, and revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥9,441 million. Sales by product type were ¥4,660 million for accessories and other gemstones, ¥2,591 million for necklaces, ¥1,355 million for diamond rings and ¥833 million for other rings. Its parent company, Senko Group Holdings Co., Ltd., holds 50.26% of the voting rights.

On the other hand, net income fell from the prior year to ¥322 million, and the situation is one in which balancing store expansion with securing earnings is an issue.
